messages:
Harper C: Quick async — working on onboarding the new ap-east-2 region. Couple of alignment asks so we don't hit surprises during the cutover.
Harper C: TL;DR: need availability-domain mapping, peering ASN confirmation, KMS ownership, and legal residency flag for EU data-in-transit customers.
Devon L: I can take availability-domain mapping. I'll compare our existing nl/eu templates and paste a diff later. ETA today EOD.
Ravi N: For peering ASNs — cloud provider gave us a pair: ASN 64522 / 64523. We need to confirm that matches upstream BGP filters and egress ACLs.
Priya S: @Ravi N noted. Who will own the BGP ACL update? I can do the infra PR but need the exact ASN list and the IP prefixes from network.
Ravi N: I'll export prefix-list now and drop it here.
ops-bot: preflight-checker: region ap-east-2 preflight started at 2026-03-17T15:12:00Z
Harper C: Re KMS: dedicated key requested by Payments team for residency. @Mike R can you confirm if we can add a cross-account IAM role for dedicated KMS with Customer Managed Key (CMK)?
Mike R: We can. Two notes: 1) CMK policy needs a single IAM role ARN from payments, 2) rotation window must be documented. I'll create the terraform module change and link the PR.
Priya S: For legal residency flag — legal-scan-bot, can you run quick check against our residency rules? We need to know if ap-east-2 is treat-as-EU for any customers (some customers allow APAC only, some EU-only).
legal-scan-bot: residency-scan: scanned 42 customers with geo filters. 3 customers have strict EU-only. None currently pinned to ap-east-2. Recommend adding region label to consent matrix: region:ap-east-2 -> not-allowed for EU-only customers.
Harper C: Good catch. We'll add that label to the consent matrix. @Devon L once you have the availability mapping paste it here so I can add it to the docs.
Devon L: Pasted diff:
```
- availability_zones: [a,b,c]
+ availability_zones: [a,c,d]
```
Devon L: Note: provider uses different naming; I normalized to our internal AZ names.
Harper C: Nice. @Priya S can you include that change in the terraform variables for region module and add a short note in the README about AZ mapping?
Priya S: Yep. I'll open PR: terraform:modules/region-ap-east-2 with AZ mapping + BGP ACL changes. PR link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4876
Ravi N: Prefix export attached: 203.0.113.0/24, 203.0.114.0/24, will add as allowed in bgp-acl.tf. Also need a fallback route policy for failover to eu-west-1.
Harper C: Who owns the failover route policy? We should have a canary flow: primary ap-east-2, fallback eu-west-1 for customers that allow multi-region. @Mike R?
Mike R: That policy lives in routing-service. I can add a policy param for region-priority and an automatic fallback TTL. Will coordinate with SRE for testing.
Harper C: Testing plan — small internal Canary org, then 1% cross-region traffic, validate latency and residency tags. @ops-bot can you register a canary job once infra PRs merge?
ops-bot: job-scheduler: scheduled job "ap-east-2-canary" pending PR merge checks.
Devon L: One more: cross-region logs need to respect residency. We must ensure logs for EU-only customers do not export to ap-east-2 logging endpoints. I'll add a filter rule.
Priya S: Adding log filter and update to logging module. Will include sample snippet in PR:
```
resource "logging_filter" "eu_only_exclude" {
  customers = var.eu_only_customers
  exclude_regions = ["ap-east-2"]
}
```
Harper C: Perfect. Summary of owners:
- Availability domain mapping: Devon L
- BGP ACLs & prefixes: Ravi N
- Terraform region module + AZ vars: Priya S
- KMS CMK & IAM role: Mike R
- Routing failover policy: Mike R (routing-service)
- Legal/residency checks: legal-scan-bot (follow-up by Harper)
- Canary/job scheduling: ops-bot
Harper C: Any blockers? If not I'll convert these into action items in the region tracker and ping stakeholders.
Priya S: No blockers from infra side. PR incoming.
Ravi N: Waiting on network ACL window from cloud provider — they said possible maintenance on Wed. That might delay BGP cutover by 24 hours.
Harper C: Noted. I'll flag that in tracker and push the canary window accordingly.
Mike R: I'll draft the CMK policy today and link it to payments' IAM role. Ping me if you need a stub policy.
Harper C: Thanks all. I'll follow up with the region tracker entry and assign the tasks. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: preflight-checker: preflight complete with warnings: "cloud-maintenance-window". See infra/alerts/6789 for details.
